cloud.headline: CLOUD ENGINEER | AWS & AZURE | CLOUD ARCHITECTURE | SECURITY

Delivered landing-zone governance, private and hybrid networking, infrastructure as code, security remediation, backup and recovery validation, monitoring, and cloud-cost controls across a large production estate.

devops.headline: DEVOPS ENGINEER | CI/CD | INFRASTRUCTURE AS CODE | AUTOMATION
devops.summary: DevOps and cloud engineer who automated AWS and Azure infrastructure and production application delivery with Terraform, Azure DevOps CI/CD, Git-reviewed changes, Kubernetes, and security checks. Improved release speed and deployment reliability by automating build, validation, provisioning, and operational workflows with Python, Bash, and PowerShell.

platform.headline: PLATFORM ENGINEER | KUBERNETES | CLOUD FOUNDATIONS
platform.summary: Platform engineer who built and operated Kubernetes and cloud foundations used by application teams. Improved developer enablement through reusable infrastructure, standardized Helm deployment patterns, self-service access automation, cluster lifecycle management, secure CI/CD, and integrated observability.

sre.headline: SITE RELIABILITY ENGINEER | OBSERVABILITY | INCIDENT RESPONSE
sre.summary: Reliability-focused cloud engineer who operated production Kubernetes and cloud services, investigated incidents, and automated recovery and capacity checks. Improved service visibility and change safety with centralized logs and metrics, controlled cluster upgrades, validated backups, and documented operational procedures.

infrastructure.headline: INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEER | CLOUD | NETWORKING | AUTOMATION
infrastructure.summary: Infrastructure engineer experienced in operating regulated Azure and AWS environments across compute, hybrid systems, Kubernetes, networking, identity, security, storage, and recovery. Automated provisioning and operations with infrastructure as code and scripting, strengthened continuity through patch and backup validation, and optimized infrastructure cost without degrading service.

experience.title: Cloud Engineer
experience.company: Equity Group Holdings / Equity Bank Kenya

bullets.t: Operated cloud infrastructure across 25+ Kubernetes clusters, 500+ microservices, 1,000+ databases, and 100+ VMs supporting 99.99% availability.
Cut environment provisioning from about four hours to 24 minutes with reusable Terraform modules and version-controlled configuration.
Applied Git-reviewed, GitOps-aligned change control to Terraform updates, improving traceability, reviewability, and consistency of infrastructure changes.
Automated cloud validation and remediation with Python, PowerShell, Azure Automation, and Ansible, reducing repetitive manual operations.
Correlated Tenable and Defender findings and automated validation and remediation with Python, Azure Automation, and Ansible, reducing the backlog from 996 findings to 2.
Raised Microsoft Secure Score from 54 to 76 by prioritizing cloud security findings with security and operations teams.
Developed a Python remediation engine that detected Kubernetes deployment failures and initiated recovery actions, contributing to 35% faster incident resolution.
Integrated cloud and platform telemetry into operational workflows, contributing to 35% faster incident resolution.
Diagnosed production incidents involving node health, memory pressure, OOM/eviction events, failed probes, and application/network timeouts to restore service safely.
Documented repeatable incident-troubleshooting runbooks for Kubernetes, cloud networking, and security investigations.
Rolled out Grafana Loki and Alloy through Terraform, Helm, and Azure DevOps across production clusters, centralizing Kubernetes logs for investigation.
Created self-service developer tooling for Loki access that opened a pull request, synchronized the requester's Entra ID group, and sent completion notifications.
Planned AKS version upgrades across nine production clusters with staged rollout, node surge, workload-health validation, and rollback criteria.
Established Azure Landing Zone governance across management groups, RBAC, Azure Policy, subscription vending, and hub-and-spoke networking.
Engineered controlled network paths with Azure CNI, Cilium, NSGs, Private Endpoints, Application Gateway, Azure Firewall, and ExpressRoute.
Applied Cilium NetworkPolicy controls to restrict unnecessary east-west and egress traffic between workloads.
Reduced cloud spend by 25% through workload rightsizing, autoscaling, idle-resource removal, and cost-governance automation.
Automated daily cloud compliance checks and resource tagging with ARM templates and Azure Resource Graph, improving ownership and remediation visibility.
Built Python capacity checks across 16+ subscriptions to surface utilization, quota headroom, and scaling risks before they constrained workloads.
Validated Azure Update Manager patch compliance across 112 Azure and Arc-enabled machines, separating real update gaps from reporting limitations.
Verified Windows TLS 1.0 and 1.1 configuration findings through registry checks and remote execution to guide remediation decisions.
Provided identity, network, encryption, and logging evidence for a third-party PCI-DSS audit that closed with zero findings.
Validated backup status, retention, recovery points, restore capability, and geo-redundancy to strengthen disaster-recovery readiness for critical workloads.
Reviewed daily application-consistent recovery points for a 250-GB MongoDB standalone database protected through Azure Backup to assess recovery coverage.
Compiled restoration logs and backup evidence for Jenga, Equitel MGW, MICA, and SMSC systems to support audit review and recovery readiness.
Built a Python least-privilege analyzer that identified excessive permissions across 200+ cloud accounts for access reviews.
Produced infrastructure design specifications and diagrams for compute, cluster topology, networking, and platform changes.
Supported Azure AI infrastructure integrations by reviewing cloud connectivity and deployment requirements for Azure AI Foundry, Kubeflow, RAG, and model-serving workloads.
Built Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines with Git, Maven, and SonarQube quality and security gates, reducing deployment time by 80%.
Reduced manual release effort by 90% by automating build, validation, and security controls in the delivery workflow.
Built repeatable Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and Helm release workflows for 20+ Java applications, reducing deployment failures by 70%.
Developed reusable Terraform modules for AWS provisioning, reducing provisioning effort by 85%.
Migrated 40+ workloads with Multi-AZ failover, supporting 99.9% business continuity with zero data loss during cutover.
Established Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, and ELK monitoring across application and infrastructure workloads, reducing incident detection time by 60%.
Troubleshot Linux, JVM, and Nginx deployment issues while applying least-privilege, secrets, and network controls, reducing MTTR by 65%.
Moved a 12+ service trade-finance platform to EKS with standardized Helm patterns, enabling independent scaling without full rearchitecture.
Decomposed trade-finance workflows into independently deployable Spring Boot microservices, reducing release coupling between application components.
Implemented RabbitMQ event processing on Amazon EKS, decoupling asynchronous trade-finance workflows and reducing synchronous service dependencies.
Secured REST APIs with OAuth2 and JWT, and integrated SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning to catch authentication and dependency risks before release.
Built 12+ Spring Boot services and 30+ REST APIs integrating SWIFT MT, IBM MQ, and ISO 15022 workflows at 99.95% transaction reliability.
Tuned JVM caching and JDBC connection pools to improve runtime resource efficiency for transaction-processing services.
Aligned Maven service builds with Docker and EKS deployment patterns, enabling teams to package and scale components independently.
Provisioned AWS and Azure infrastructure with Terraform and Ansible, reducing client provisioning effort by approximately 95%.
Deployed and operated AKS and Confluent for Kubernetes across development, test, performance, and production environments, supporting 99.9% client workload availability.
Automated repeatable infrastructure and release workflows with Python, PowerShell, Terraform, and Ansible, cutting recurring deployment effort by 50%.
Built reusable AWS, Azure, and GCP landing-zone modules with Open Policy Agent checks to validate infrastructure policy before deployment.
Restructured EFS, S3, Aurora, and AWS Backup architecture to reduce client infrastructure costs by approximately 40% without service degradation.
Reduced new-environment onboarding time for clients without dedicated platform teams by standardizing multi-cloud Terraform foundations.
